finding: A8.75 HIGH F1 - UNSW train/test protocol was swapped (trained on the smaller partition).

verification.canonical_reference: Official UNSW-NB15 partition: training-set = 175,341 records, testing-set = 82,332 records (Moustafa & Slay). The local file NAMES are swapped relative to canonical row counts.
verification.conclusion: The local file names do not match canonical sizes. By canonical ROW COUNT, the 175,341-row partition is the benchmark training set and the 82,332-row partition is the benchmark test set.

decision: Correct to the standard UNSW-NB15 protocol: train/val from the 175,341-row partition (local UNSW_NB15_testing-set.csv); final test on the 82,332-row partition (local UNSW_NB15_training-set.csv).
implementation: Swapped train_file/test_file in configs/preprocessing/unsw_nb15_binary.yaml (assigned by canonical row count, with explanatory comments); raw files were NOT renamed or modified.

corrected_split.val_source: 85/15 stratified-on-binary split of the train source (random_seed=42)

rare_class_support_after_correction.note: Before correction Worms had train=40/val=4; the corrected protocol raises Worms to train=109/val=21, removing the <50 very-low-support warning and stabilizing validation macro-F1.
